hero.title: Crafting authentic web experiences.
hero.desc: Passionate about transforming complex ideas into fluid, interactive, and impactful interfaces. The intersection where engineering meets art.

about.desc: I am a front-end developer and I am also on both sides of the camera, working as a model and content creator. This changed how I think about interfaces: I started noticing how people actually look at a screen before deciding whether they stay or leave. Today, I design and implement.
about.quote: The performance of a system shouldn't compromise its beauty, nor should aesthetics hinder functional fluidity.

work.desc: These are the projects where I did both the design and the implementation. I like this format because visual decisions don't end before the code begins: many things only become clear when I see the interface actually working, and then I adjust. There is no closed stage waiting for someone else to execute: it's all the same person deciding, from the first sketch to the final result.

personalProjects.desc: My work beyond the code. Here I share my passions and experiences from the other side of the camera, from modeling and digital influence to the culture that inspires me every day.

contact.subtitle: Feel free to send me a message.
